description: This Java source file defines a Fragment subclass 'LogFragment' that manages a view displaying log data via a custom 'LogView'. It provides methods for inflating the view hierarchy, setting up the log view, and ensuring the latest log entries are visible by scrolling to the bottom when text changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that encapsulates a LogView within a ScrollView, facilitating display of log data and automatic scrolling to display the most recent logs.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, sets layout parameters, padding, typeface, and gravity, then returns the ScrollView containing the LogView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, adds a TextWatcher to scroll to the bottom after text changes, and returns the assembled view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
